description: Give a brief (product, audience, length, platform) and 1-5 references (REF ids, links or ids, or your brand films' brand:<import>:<film> ids), and optionally one of your imported brands (brand) to plan in its house style. Returns, per reference, the plates that carry its timing and look (format, hook, beat sheet, style, sound, edit recipe) plus its recipe prompt, and the one formula that best matches, with instructions to write a shot list and a build prompt for the user's own video. With several references it also says how to mix them: one spine for structure and timing, and one named job for each of the others. Name the spine first if you already know it. Then, like an editor, it storyboards before anything is built: you draft the storyboard (1 direction for a fixed brief, 2–4 for an open one), check it with the storyboard tool and lay it out as a Claude Design canvas, the user picks a direction, and only then do you write the build prompt. For every plate of one film, use get_blueprint. Needs a Refs account with Pro; without one, the app asks the user to sign in. search_videos is free.

brand.description: One of your brand imports (id or @handle, from list_brands): its brand kit becomes the house-style constraint

brief.description: What the user wants to make

reference_ids.description: REF-0005, refs.video/v/… or YouTube/X links, ids (get_collection lists a collection's films), or brand:<import>:<film> ids. Optional with brand: then the brand's own top films are the references

name: plan_video
